plugins.name: winnow
plugins.description: Requirements and roadmap management skills: winnow (distil input into a reviewable proposal), update-context (fold approved knowledge into the project's AI context), create-tasks (turn approved work items into tracker tickets), transcribe-audio (local Whisper transcription of files and live streams), listen-to-meeting (flag contradictions and gaps live during a meeting) and setup-winnow (one guided pass that prepares the machine and the project for all of them).
